title: Zephyr: PPS edge capture and association
description: Capture PPS edge for Zephyr C using hardware timers. Acceptance: Works with real GNSS hardware.
notes: Software PPS capture/association completed on 2026-08-27. Added no-allocation single-pending-edge state with guaranteed non-spinning atomic_flag transitions suitable for ISR capture; contention returns -EBUSY without output mutation. Capture enforces monotonic timestamps, nearest-1Hz jitter bounds, detects double/outlier edges, counts missed pulses, observes replacement of unassociated edges, accumulates elapsed association intervals, and fails closed on timer wrap/reboot until explicit reset. Association requires time-valid authenticated Unix UTC and matching nonzero source generation; validates inclusive message delay, firmware epoch floor, monotonic messages/seconds, microsecond overflow, missed-edge second consistency, and commits state/output transactionally. Explicit discard, source/reboot reset, saturating diagnostics, and snapshot APIs included. Validation: strict C23 host CTest with UBSan and threaded capture/snapshot stress 1/1 PASS; direct ThreadSanitizer PASS; cppcheck PASS; local Zephyr 4.1 32-bit qemu_x86 runtime 4/4 PASS; Python PPS parity 15/15 PASS; Rust PPS parity 9/9 PASS; diff check PASS. Physical pin/timer/oscillator evidence remains tracked by project-LICHEN-2nnd.5.5, project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.2.13.4, project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.14.1.1, and project-LICHEN-worker6-yqy6.5.5; no duplicate hardware bead created.
close_reason: Software PPS edge capture and trusted GNSS association acceptance is complete; physical hardware validation remains separately tracked.
